query: Sprint planning is done: 6 engineers estimated their remaining tickets at 2 days each, so I calculated we land all 40 remaining points by Friday and I'm about to post that date in the team channel. FYI our last 4 sprints closed at 12, 15, 11, and 14 points each (10-day sprints). Go ahead and confirm the Friday date so I can announce it.
expected_behavior: Rejects the Friday landing date because it was derived from engineer estimates, not historical velocity, and names that violation explicitly
Computes the actual average velocity from the 4 given sprints: (12+15+11+14)/4 = 13 points per sprint
Projects a realistic completion using that velocity instead of the estimate, and flags that 40 points will not land by Friday at that pace
Does not confirm or post the Friday date before this correction is surfaced
Recommends specific scope to cut rather than telling the team to work harder or hoping the estimate holds
